open_points.subject: trial and admission input materialization
open_points.text: "one implementation, one case's inputs and the contract's ResourceBounds M04 cross into module:sandbox"
open_points.question: Which module resolves each TrialCase StoredValue, including file fixtures, into actual JSON values or bytes before execute_function, and through which capability?
options: module:functions reads every input through capability:store.read_value_bytes and decodes it before calling the sandbox
module:sandbox receives StoredValue references and reads their bytes itself
open_points.default_guess: module:functions reads and decodes the inputs through capability:store.read_value_bytes before calling module:sandbox

open_points.subject: flow constant byte persistence
open_points.text: "A new version is written with its constants, each with the class the agent declared"
open_points.question: When and by whom are a new flow version's constant bytes written to the content-addressed area before its StoredValues and FlowVersion are recorded?
options: record_change accepts and publishes constant bytes together with the records
open_points.default_guess: module:flows calls capability:store.put_value_bytes for every new constant before recording its StoredValue and FlowVersion

open_points.subject: run input byte persistence
open_points.text: "writes the Run running with its pins, starter and start time, and the input values with their identities and their port's class"
open_points.question: How are flow-input bytes published so the StoredValues written at run start remain readable during execution and after restart?
options: module:runs calls capability:store.put_value_bytes before recording the Run and StoredValues
the Run record_change call also accepts and publishes the input bytes
open_points.default_guess: module:runs publishes each input through capability:store.put_value_bytes before recording the Run and StoredValues

open_points.subject: function output byte persistence
open_points.text: "module:runs writes the element's NodeExecution and the outputs"
open_points.question: How are successful function value-output bytes published before their StoredValues and NodeExecution references are recorded?
options: module:runs calls capability:store.put_value_bytes before its outcome record_change
the outcome record_change call publishes the value bytes as part of the same operation
open_points.default_guess: module:runs calls capability:store.put_value_bytes first, leaving unreferenced bytes for start-up cleanup if the later record change fails

open_points.subject: operation input materialization
open_points.text: "JSON values are placed as capability:canonical_values.canonical_bytes, and file inputs are read through capability:store.read_value_bytes"
open_points.question: Who reads and decodes value-carriage StoredValues before service_invoker builds the request, approval preview and idempotency key?
options: module:effects reads value and file bytes through capability:store.read_value_bytes
module:runs materializes the values and passes their content to module:effects
module:service_invoker receives StoredValue references and reads their bytes
open_points.default_guess: module:effects reads and decodes all element inputs through capability:store.read_value_bytes before request preparation

open_points.subject: read-operation output byte persistence
open_points.text: "module:effects writes the concluding NodeExecution and the output values, class from the binding"
open_points.question: How are value outputs of a read operation published before the StoredValues and concluding NodeExecution that reference them are recorded?
options: module:effects calls capability:store.put_value_bytes before its outcome record_change
the outcome record_change call accepts and publishes the response value bytes
open_points.default_guess: module:effects calls capability:store.put_value_bytes before recording the output StoredValues and NodeExecution

open_points.subject: effect-operation output byte persistence
open_points.text: "A second store call writes the outcome: the attempt's conclusion from the non-read column of A09 rule 5, the next NodeExecution, the output values, and the approval used"
open_points.question: Where in the two-call effect protocol are successful service value-output bytes published, and what operation performs that publication?
options: module:effects calls capability:store.put_value_bytes after the response and before the second record_change
the second record_change call publishes both the bytes and the records
open_points.default_guess: module:effects publishes the bytes through capability:store.put_value_bytes before the second store call records the outcome

open_points.subject: installed-instance manifest validation
open_points.text: "a manifest record that cannot be read or fails a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5) stops the start naming it"
open_points.question: Which exact A08 rule 5 checks run at start, and over which capability entries, when check_installed_instances has no proposed operation name or ports with which to perform the operation-specific checks?
options: Check only service-record readability, JSON shape, matching service id, capability-name uniqueness and the selected instance facts needed for header collision
Validate every capability entry using a separately defined start-time order while omitting proposal-port checks
Remove this manifest-validity start check and check only credential-header collisions against a readable selected instance
open_points.default_guess: Check only the service-level and selected-instance facts needed to locate required headers and detect the credential-header collision
